cards.title: Wannier-projected Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian

source_refs.value: Main text, computational method: Ni 3d/O 2p atomic-centered Wannier basis

checks.reason: The PBE plane-wave to Ni 3d/O 2p Wannier construction is stated explicitly.
The independent parser and Fourier interpolator reject a non-Hermitian H(k).

cards.numerical_form: Parse public Wannier90 H(R), divide by degeneracy, and Fourier sum on each declared k point.
open_questions: The exact projector gauge and disentanglement window are not printed.

cards.title: Interacting lattice Green function

source_refs.value: Main text, fully charge-self-consistent DFT+DMFT method

checks.reason: The multi-site DFT+DMFT Dyson construction follows the stated method.
Independent layered-model tests preserve Hermiticity, inversion symmetry, and retarded causality.

cards.numerical_form: Embed one local self-energy block per inequivalent Ni layer and invert the orbital matrix independently for every k and frequency.
open_questions: The exact layer-to-projector mapping is not published.

cards.title: DMFT local projection and Weiss field

source_refs.value: Main text, one impurity per inequivalent Ni site

checks.reason: The article assigns one impurity to each inequivalent Ni layer; the local projection and Weiss update are the standard DMFT closure.
Layer blocks are averaged over k before the scalar/matrix Weiss update.
Symmetry-related top and bottom layers converge to equal occupancies below 1e-15 in validation.

cards.numerical_form: Project the k-averaged Green function into each inequivalent Ni d block and apply the matrix Dyson equation.

cards.title: Density-density Slater-Kanamori interaction and CT-HYB

source_refs.value: Main text: density-density U=10 eV, J=1 eV and CT-HYB

checks.reason: U, J, density-density restriction, temperature, and CT-HYB are printed.
Tests independently verify U, U-2J, and U-3J flavor matrix entries.

cards.numerical_form: Build the ten-flavor Ni d density interaction and execute independent public TRIQS/cthyb chains for each inequivalent layer.
open_questions: The paper does not report cycles, seeds, average sign, estimators, or autocorrelation controls.

cards.title: Fully localized limit double counting

source_refs.value: Main text: fully localized double-counting correction

checks.reason: The fully localized limit convention is stated.
Independent tests verify the occupancy-dependent scalar formula.

cards.numerical_form: Update V_DC from the layer-resolved d occupancy at every DMFT iteration.
open_questions: The paper does not print converged layer occupancies at full precision.

cards.title: Charge feedback fixed point

source_refs.value: Main text: fully charge self-consistent implementation

checks.reason: Full charge self-consistency is required by the article and by the execution contract.
The production runner owns the outer fixed point and fails closed when the unpublished plane-wave density-injection seam is absent.

cards.numerical_form: Iterate QE charge density, Wannier Hamiltonian, layer impurity solutions, and density correction until charge and self-energy tolerances both pass.
open_questions: The plane-wave density-injection convention, exact mixing schedule, and convergence history are not published.

cards.title: Spectral functions and orbital projections

source_refs.value: Main Figs. 1,2,4,5 and Supplement Figs. S1,S2

checks.reason: The paper explicitly reports k-resolved and layer/orbital-resolved spectra using MaxEnt and Pade.
Independent retarded spectra are nonnegative and satisfy the finite-window sum rule within 0.7 percent.

cards.numerical_form: Continue independently by MaxEnt and rational Pade, solve retarded Dyson, then trace or select layer/orbital blocks without pixel sampling.
open_questions: MaxEnt covariance/default model and final plotting broadening are not printed.

cards.title: Imaginary-time local spin correlation

checks.reason: The definition and layer/orbital curves are printed in the article.
The exact atomic validator obeys chi(tau)=chi(beta-tau) to machine precision.

cards.numerical_form: Accumulate spin-density correlators during CT-HYB and verify the equilibrium imaginary-time reflection symmetry.
open_questions: The precise CT-HYB correlation estimator and binning are not printed.

cards.title: Symmetric slab surface energy

checks.reason: The paper reports DMFT and GGA surface energies for both orientations.
A constructed 59 meV/A^2 symmetric-slab excess is recovered to machine precision.

cards.numerical_form: Subtract the matched bulk reference at equal stoichiometry and divide by two equivalent surface areas.
open_questions: The paper does not publish full-precision slab and bulk total energies.
